name: Tabkheer
indication_description:
Tabkheer is indicated in-
  • Gastroesophageal reflux disorders
  • Flatulence
  • Indigestion
  • Hyperacidity
dosage_description: 1-2 capsule(s) daily or as prescribed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been reported in therapeutic dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Store in cool and dry place, protect from light.
